description: Réseau d'éclairage public_lignes électriques de la CCPOP is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes du Pays d'Orange en Provence. Location of overhead and underground power lines of the public lighting network of the territory managed by the Community of communes of the Pays d'Orange in Provence. Coverage: Communauté de Communes du Pays d'Orange en Provence. The portal shows the English title as "Public lighting network _electric lines of the CCPOP" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes du Pays d'Orange en Provence. Its keywords include reseau, ligne-electrique, eclairage-public. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
